checks.ref: command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh; if grep -n '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "the tasks listed above are open again - the fix-code stage must leave tasks.md as implement left it"; exit 1; fi

command:base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main); oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-code#/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
outside=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep . | grep -v '^packages/client/' | grep -vxF "$reports/review-code.md" || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the fix-code stage edits only packages/client/ and the resolutions in $reports/review-code.md - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-code#/ { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
review="$reports/review-code.md"
hunks=$(git diff -U0 "$since" -- "$review" | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(---|\+\+\+) ' || true)
removed=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^-' | grep -vxF -- '-- Status: open' || true)
added=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+(- Status: |- Resolution: |  +[^ ])' || true)
[ -z "$removed$added" ] || { printf '%s\n' "$removed" "$added" | grep .; echo "only the '- Status:' lines and the new '- Resolution:' lines (continuation lines indented) of $review may change - restore the rest with: git checkout $since -- $review, then re-apply the statuses"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R2 fix breaks the file-size rule: packages/client/src/test/features/browser_compatibility/steps/browser_compatibility_legacy_zones.steps.ts is now 214 lines (189 before the fix). CLAUDE.md Process Invariants says "Files must stay under 200 lines for AI context quality", and the review's own Fix risk for R2 said "steps/browser_compatibility_legacy_zones.steps.ts is 189 lines, so new helpers belong in legacyZoneWorld.ts (82 lines) to keep both under 200". Move the new storage helpers into steps/legacyZoneWorld.ts (95 lines): `loadStoredZoneIds` (lines 43-50) and the save-then-load body of "the stored list holds {string}" (lines 114-123), for example as `saveAndLoadStoredZoneIds(modules, locations)` and `loadStoredZoneIds(modules)`. That brings the steps file back under 200 lines.
